title: Paper White 2: the Following Pokémon's interactions, res/paperwhite2/following/interactions.json
description: What the follower does when the player talks to it (following/interactions.bin of Pokeweb's runtime, "FWTK" ABI 1), packed by tools/paperwhite2/following_assets.py as member 3 of the model table's archive (a/0/4/7), whose docstring has the format. The runtime rolls each rule in order and takes the first that matches and passes its chance; the last must always match. A rule runs its steps: each can play a motion, show a message and a bubble, and cry. The motions, messages and bubbles came from HeartGold's neutral-mood reactions (a/2/2/0 to a/2/2/2, messages of bank 265, emotes of a/1/0/3), whose numbers the hgss_ fields keep. A string value of a turn is a DIR_* constant of include/constants/directions.h.

motions.description: The motions that steps play, numbered from 1; the contextual dialogues' before_motion and after_motion name them by these numbers too

messages.description: The messages that steps show, numbered from 1

bubbles.description: The emote bubbles that steps show over the Pokémon, numbered from 1; each has two frames, emotes/<name>_1.png and _2.png, members 6 and on of a/0/4/7, two a bubble in this order

hp.description: The HP the Pokémon has left; without it, any

friendship.description: The Pokémon's friendship; without it, any

status.description: The Pokémon's status condition (poison takes in bad poison, any_status any but healthy); without it, any

facing.description: The way the Pokémon faces to look at the player, which is where the player stands from it; without it, any

hgss_reaction.description: The HeartGold reaction it came from (a/2/2/1 member + 1); the runtime only needs it not 0

chance.description: The chance in percent that it is taken when it matches

motion.description: The motion it plays, from 1, 0 for none

message.description: The message it shows, from 1, 0 for none

cry.description: Whether the Pokémon cries, and whether slowed down (PokeVoice_AdjustSpeed)

bubble.description: The bubble it shows, from 1, 0 for none

hgss_motion.description: The HeartGold motion it came from (a/2/2/2 member + 1)

turn.description: The way the Pokémon turns to face, null to keep its facing

x.description: The pixels it moves the Pokémon's drawing east

y.description: The pixels it moves the Pokémon's drawing up, except Diglett's and Dugtrio's, which stay in the ground

z.description: The pixels it moves the Pokémon's drawing south

cry.description: Whether the step's start plays the Pokémon's cry, if the rule's step cries

hgss_message.description: The HeartGold message it came from (of bank 265)

text.description: The text, at most 127 characters: \n starts a line, {nickname} is the Pokémon's nickname, {player} the player's name

name.description: The name of its frames' files, emotes/<name>_1.png and .pal and emotes/<name>_2.png and .pal

texture.description: The name of its texture sets' palette, and of their textures with .1 and .2, as HeartGold names them

hgss_emote.description: The HeartGold emote it came from

durations.description: The frames each of its four steps shows for

frames.description: The frame each step shows: 0 its first, 1 its second
